reviews.x: I have been shaving with a regular razor for years. But I also need an electric one with a trimmer for  nose hair. My old one stopped working so I purchased this one. I was surprised by the quality of the design. I will use it for travel too and was surprised to find this one displays the number of minutes remaining on the battery before it needs to  be recharged. I tried it out only once, as I just received it. But the results were very good.

reviews.t: Just ok -- it actually bit me!
reviews.x: I was a bit taken in by the 5-star reviews for this shaver.  It didn’t work too good for me though.  I have a really thick beard and it grows fast.  Electrics just can’t get it all.  I typically shave with an electric, but follow up with an Atra dry shave to clean up missed spots.  I’ve tried all the major vendors and none knock it out of the park.  The blade on this one cuts just ok and it’s not comfortable…and it actually bit me once..lol.  Never had that problem out of the major vendors.  I u

Always used  brand name [more expensive] wet electric shavers. Worked well but the blades typically last only a year to 18 mos. before they dull and perform badly. This one may do the same. But in the meantime it provides a smooth, close shave with a battery life indicator light as well. At the price, replacement, even every year, is a value.
This razor just died. Purchased on Jan10,2020 so only lasted 5 months. Won’t even charge now. So disappointed as it worked fine up until now.
Bought for my husband for his birthday and it doesn’t cut well
I like it very much, good buy for the money, works very good.
My son said it hurts and refuses to user it

reviews.t: Not great for thick, coarse facial hair
reviews.x: My husband has to shave everyday for work and usually uses a Braun Series 7 shaver so I thought I'd have him try this much cheaper electric razor. He used it once and immediately said "it sucks." He had to go over the same areas multiple times and it wasn't nearly as close a shave as the Braun, which isn't really surprising considering the huge price difference. Some pros: the packaging was presentable and easy to open, it arrived fully charged and ready to use, a USB power adapter was included,

The distributer of this electric shaver is EDUP HOME although you won't find that name on the packing material or the instruction sheet. The model number is FK-605.  The instructions are like a satire of the English language challenged technical writers.  The illustrations are ludicrous and of minimal help in learning how to operate this device.  Fortunately the operation is quite straight-forward.  Mine fired right up and gave an excellent shave and the trimmer was easy to use on my sideburns.

reviews.t: Closest to a blade shave yet.
reviews.x: Overall I'm very pleasantly surprised by this.  I've shaved with many electric razors over the years, starting with a hand me down Norelco from my Dad, a number of Braun's, a Remington.  This gives a nice shave.  I'm fair skinned so I don't have a real tough beard, but often found that has few electric razors give as close a shave to a blade.  This may be the best yet.  Battery life after almost two weeks seems very good.  Haven't charged it yet and it shows 85% left.  So far so good.  And defin

reviews.t: Not a Close, Comfortable Shave for Me
reviews.x: There are some nice features in this new shaver, but, alas, in its primary function, this wireless shaver falls short.  First, what I liked: the charging cable can connect to USB, which greatly impressed me; the ease with which I could clean the shaver after each use; the pop-up trimmer.  Second, what I found wanting: the cut! It tended to pull some hairs and failed to easily cut close to the skin. Worse still, my face was stinging as if I had splashed it with aftershave.  BOTTOM LINE  Three sta

Tried to get information on the replacement head. Send multiple emails but no response.  I am tired . I am going to return this to Amazon and get a Braun. I can get the customer service and parts everywhere.  I guess this is what happens to cheap Chinese products.  Please stay away from this product . Pay extra and get a reputable and a product that has a customer service dept and a telephone number.

This electric shaver is honestly way better than i expected, my face has never been this smooth and it performed better than electric shavers that were priced at $40-$50. This electric shaver gives you 99 minutes of use and only takes 2 hours to charge and is very easy to clean as well. Before buying this product keep in mind that it is washable not waterproof so do not take it into the shower.

Works better than expected. Upon opening it, It was already fully charged and ready to go. It is possible to get a clean shave with this and its impossible to cut yourself with it, so far after a few shaves, I have yet to break skin with it! Its also pretty easy to clean and come with a small brush to help clean it, the blades are also replaceable which will help with longevity.

This electric shaver is compact, easy to clean with or without using water, and has plenty of battery charge.  Trimmer works well but hard to get at hair along the ears.  Closeness of shave is good but less that some rotary electric shavers so takes a little longer to get a satisfactory close shave.  Overall well satisfied as I became tired of a wet razor shave all these years.

My favorite part of this razor is the trimmer. It works great for my son's beard, keeping it looking well groomed. Flex heads provide good shaving action over all facial curves. Needs to charge frequently but not a problem when only used a few minutes each day. This is a good razor set that makes a great gift for the man in your life.

Was skeptical about this shaver ( since it is an off name brand ) but, it came fully charged and worked amazing on my husband! He has a hard time with shavers because he has very thick and coarse hair! This shaver went straight through it all.  (Only had a couple days. Can not vouch for longevity.) So far, so good!!

I tried using this electric razor twice, first time completely dry, the second time with shaving cream and warm water.  Both times this razor left aweful razor burns all over my neck and chin, I'm very disappointed with this razor.  It worked perfect for my mustache and beard, but any other areas it burns very bad.

Perfect. I started shopping the most expensive electric Shaver and discovered that this model is priced mid-range, but has a higher percentage of satisfied customers than the more expensive razors. So I chose this one. It was the right choice. Closest, smoothest shave ever. I couldn't beat it with a hand razor.

reviews.t: Cordless & waterproof on the go shaver
reviews.x: I bought this for my husband who is always on the go.  It’s cordless, charges quickly, and lasts for more than 90mins.  He uses it in the shower cause it’s also waterproof, and if he’s running late for work, takes it along for a quick shave in the truck once he gets there.  He loves It!!

Got it as a backup, and it works great for the cost. The trimmer is a bonus. The shaver follows the face contours with ease, and the cleaning  is easy. I am going to use this during travel going on. I also like the USB charging mechanism.  Would recommend for purchase.

I’m a barber and I went from the Andis Profoil Shavers to these ....absolutely necessary. It glides so smoothly on all textures. I always remove bulk with my trimmers or clippers first then I proceed with the electric shavers and it’s so smooth. No irritation either.

reviews.t: Spend the extra money and skip this
reviews.x: This product was not expensive but you get what you pay for. Did not hold a charge and we found the design to be awkward. I returned it, spent the money on a name brand. I hate to give bad reviews, but this was really not a good design.

reviews.t: Everything I need in an electric razor.
reviews.x: This razor is exactly as advertised. The parts are quality and have held up through usage. The battery life is quite impressive too, and I like that the display on the razor actually tells you how many minutes of battery life are left.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it a good value for the price, delivering a close shave at a low cost.
Several reviewers report it does not cut well, especially for thick or coarse facial hair, requiring multiple passes.
Some reviewers praise the design and ease of cleaning, including the pop-up trimmer and USB charging.
A few reviewers report durability problems, with the unit dying or failing to charge after a short time.
Some reviewers complain about discomfort or poor customer service and parts availability.
